title: Evaluation of a base-changed affine-line integration through projection
statement:
Use the finite-coefficient purity conventions [def-pur-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, $n\geq1$, and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. All schemes and morphisms below are separated finite type over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Work with the small pro-etale derived categories, derived pullback and tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], compact supports [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], Tate twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], and $D^b_{ctf}$ as in [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Write $\otimes=\otimes_A^L$ and $\rho$ for the right tensor unitor. Let $f:X\to Y$, let $a:\mathbf A^1_Y\to Y$, and put $P=X\times_Y\mathbf A^1_Y=\mathbf A^1_X$, with projections $q:P\to X$ and $r:P\to\mathbf A^1_Y$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-sbc-affine-space]. Set $h=fq=ar$, $T=A_{\mathbf A^1_Y}(1)[2]$, and $U=Ra_!T$. Let $M\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$, and assume $V=Rf_!M$ and $U$ are in $D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$. Let $t_Y:U\to A_Y$ and $t_X:Rq_!r^*T\to A_X$ be the normalized line integrations of [def-pur-affine-line-purity-comparison], with its canonical Tate pullback identification. Write
$$E=\operatorname{Ex}_!:Lf^*U\xrightarrow{\sim}Rq_!Lr^*T$$
for the specified compact-support exchange [def-exchange-projection], and assume the equality $Lf^*t_Y=t_XE$. Put $W=Lq^*M\otimes Lr^*T$. Use the normalized composition comparison $\alpha: Rf_!Rq_!\xrightarrow{\sim}Rh_!$ [thm-sf-comp-composition], and let $\Pi^q_M:Rq_!W\xrightarrow{\sim}M\otimes Rq_!Lr^*T$ be the two-symmetry inverse projection map of [def-pur-affine-line-purity-comparison]. The exchange $E$, the projection map $P_U=\operatorname{PF}_{f,M,U}$ [def-exchange-projection], and $\Pi^q_M$ are isomorphisms on these inputs. Define
$$C=Rf_!(1_M\otimes E^{-1})\,Rf_!(\Pi^q_M)\,\alpha_W^{-1}:Rh_!W\to Rf_!(M\otimes Lf^*U),$$
$$D=P_U^{-1}C:Rh_!W\longrightarrow V\otimes U.$$
With $b_{q,M}=\rho_M(1_M\otimes t_X)\Pi^q_M$, the actual maps satisfy
$$Rf_!(b_{q,M})\,\alpha_W^{-1}=\rho_V(1_V\otimes t_Y)D.$$
The projection transformations here are the specified proper-counit/open-tensor composites, not arbitrary isomorphisms between the displayed objects. No exceptional inverse image, purity isomorphism, or identification of $D$ with a Kunneth map is assumed.

proof.text: Choose an ordinary bounded constructible representative Me of M using its given constructibleFiniteTor certificate. Reflect the given Tor interval along the comparison, giving Me finite Tor amplitude. The explicit affine-line sourceWitness supplies its bounded-below ordinary tensor source. Tensor linePullback with Lq*M to identify the literal pulledLine source with this standard source; transfer plusEtaleOrigin along the resulting isomorphism. This supplies the existential witness hW of Evaluation without adding an assumption.

Fix F=Rf_!(cf), S=Lf*, TX=M tensor -, TY=FM tensor -, and u=TX(e_f) followed by rho_M. The naturality square of the actual projection transformation at tY gives TY(tY);PF_1 = PF_U;F(TX(S(tY))). Apply the compared-coefficient right-unit normalization PF_1;F(u)=rho_(FM). Since PF_U is invertible, cancellation gives PF_U^-1;TY(tY);rho_(FM) = F(TX(S(tY));u). No inversion of PF_1 is used.

The assumed TraceCompatible equation and invertibility of E give E^-1;S(tY);e_f=tX. Expand comparisonD, comparisonC and projectionTensorTrace. Substitute the preceding inverse-projection evaluation, combine consecutive functor maps, use tensor functoriality, and substitute the exchange contraction. Both sides become alpha_W^-1 followed by F(Pi_q;TX(tX);rho_M).
